methodology.path: authenticateRelay + readReviewJson + empty-input validation + cleanupArchive + verifyDriveArchive + real isolated D1/R2 HEAD/DELETE
methodology.relay: Independent Free Worker verifies request HMAC; signs an independently precomputed synthetic SHA receipt. No image bytes returned to reader; no real Drive calls.
methodology.images: High-entropy valid synthetic PNGs, native R2 PUT SHA-256 verified; decimal capacity simulated in isolated D1.
methodology.cpu: Cloudflare tail cpuTime in milliseconds; missing UNKNOWN, not zero. Harness budget UPDATE and trace log overhead included.
methodology.cpu_profile: Raw DB/R2 bindings without Proxy instrumentation. SDK operation counts are measured in a separate instrumented phase.
methodology.memory: Not measured; no heap or memory peak claim
